additionalDocuments.label: SAMANA Lake Views 2 · original official brochure and home drawings

review.imagery: Sixteen own-source project renders cover the complete tower, pool deck, chess, gardens, basketball, golf, gym, lobby and home interiors. All fourteen extracted native resources and six primary gallery files were visually reviewed against the complete brochure. The full street frontage supplies the card and hero. The developer reuses its lobby and gym illustrations in the Lake Views and Lake Views 2 brochures. These remain attributed proposed marketing renders. Generic swimming, technology, valet and vehicle photographs are excluded.
review.floorPlans: Three complete official home sheets show studio, 1 BR and 2 BR pool layouts. Seven complete building sheets from Mitchell’s branded broker mirror cover the exact floor groups through floor 21. The floorplate legend also identifies 2 BR + M homes, without a separate detailed home drawing. Floor 20 retains its different category legend. Numerical home areas and contractual numbered-unit matching are not printed. Confirm the selected layout, area and pool provision with SAMANA. All three official home sheets 29–31 and all seven complete mirror floorplates 2–8 were visually reviewed. Floor 10 is separate from the floors 2–9 and 11–17 group. All floors 1–21 are covered without an incorrect continuous grouping. The 2 BR + M category is retained in the source legends, with no invented detailed layout. Original unit numbers, north marker and complete sheet content remain intact.
review.location: The complete original map on physical page 10 and all twelve travel entries on page 9 were visually reviewed. The primary and brochure agree on their ranges. The broad Downtown label, historical school identities and route scope remain qualified. The published name-only map query retains the primary HTML hash. No entrance coordinate is inferred.
review.provenance: Official primary HTML, brochure, native render origins and Mitchell’s complete branded building-plan PDF have receipts and SHA256 checks. The plan mirror remains explicitly labeled. Full source sheets, original PDFs and physical PDF-page links are preserved. Protected identity and completed text research remain intact.

unavailable: Drawing-specific numerical home areas, a separate detailed 2 BR + M drawing, contractual numbered-unit matching, exact visitor entrance coordinates, current school campus identities, exact Downtown destination, final unit views/finishes and dated construction photographs were not established.
